claims: The #2 seed Purdue Boilermakers defeated the #11 seed Texas Longhorns 79-77 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 on March 26, 2026.
The game was at the SAP Center in San Jose, California.
The game was the West Regional Semifinal.
Trey Kaufman-Renn hit a tip-in with 0.7 seconds remaining to break a 77-77 tie.
The tip-in followed a missed runner by Braden Smith.
Purdue advanced to the Elite Eight.
Texas opened the second half with a 14-6 run.
The teams traded leads through the 10-minute mark.
